title: Wilbur and Orville Wright: The First Airplane
summary: Райт ах дүүс 1903 онд хөдөлгүүртэй онгоцоор дэлхийд анх удаа ниссэн.

source.name: VOA Learning English
source.credit: Marilyn Rice Christiano, John Russell · VOA Learning English
source.creditLine: Marilyn Rice Christiano wrote this story for VOA Learning English. John Russell adapted it.

questions.prompt: What did the Wright brothers do?
options: They flew the first airplane with an engine
They invented the first gas-filled balloon
They built the first vehicle to go into space
questions.explain: "They made the world's first flight in a machine that was heavier than air and powered by an engine" гэж бичсэн.

questions.prompt: How long was Orville in the air on the first flight?
questions.explain: "Orville flew the plane 36 meters. He was in the air for 12 seconds" гэж бичсэн. 36 нь метр, минут биш.

questions.prompt: Why did the brothers test their ideas at Kitty Hawk?
options: It had the best wind conditions
It was close to their home in Dayton
questions.explain: Тэдэнд "the best place with the best wind conditions" буюу салхины нөхцөл хамгийн сайтай газар хэрэгтэй байсан тул Kitty Hawk-ийг сонгосон.
